gloss: to be crushed; to collapse; to go bankrupt

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {潰|つぶ}れていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be crushed; to be squashed
definitions.explanation: For something to be flattened or deformed by pressure.
For a business, plan, or organization to fail or go bankrupt.

definitions.gloss: to be wasted; to be ruined
definitions.explanation: For time, a day, or opportunity to be lost or wasted.

notes:
{潰|つぶ}れる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to be crushed or to fail.

TRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧ (to crush, to destroy)
- {潰|つぶ}れる: The can gets crushed.
- ⟦{潰|つぶ}す→潰す：00410_tsubusu⟧: I crush the can.

ASPECT (ている):
{潰|つぶ}れている indicates something has been crushed/has failed and remains so.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潰|つぶ}れる — [thing] gets crushed/fails
- [business]⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潰|つぶ}れる — [business] goes bankrupt
- ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潰|つぶ}れる (company goes bankrupt)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潰|つぶ}れる (plans fall through)
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{潰|つぶ}れる (voice becomes hoarse)
- ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{潰|つぶ}れる (to pass out drunk)

COLLOQUIAL USE:
{潰|つぶ}れる is commonly used for businesses closing, but also casually for getting too drunk (⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{潰|つぶ}れる).
